input.title: Christmas – We Said No Gifts. We Lied. Mug
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

We said no gifts. We lied: a funny Christmas mug for the couple or family that broke the no-gift pact again. A 1960s husband and wife stand back to back in front of a decorated tree, each hiding a wrapped present behind their back, his in mustard paper with a red ribbon and hers in cream paper with a sage ribbon, and both of them smiling like they got away with it. Every year somebody swears nobody is buying anything, and every year there is a package under the tree with a name on it.

The print is faded red, mustard, sage green and cream with a worn screen-print edge. WE SAID NO GIFTS. runs across the top in bold red slab capitals and WE LIED. runs across the bottom in heavy black capitals, big enough to read across the kitchen table, on bright white glossy ceramic. The same design is printed on both sides, so it faces out in either hand.

It matches our We Said No Gifts tee and the crewneck, so a pair of mugs can sit next to a pair of sweatshirts at the family party. It also works as a small stocking gift, a white elephant pick or one of the christmas gifts for couples who always say they are skipping presents, and it will keep making the same point long after the wrapping paper is gone. Fill it with cocoa, coffee or cider on Christmas morning and wait to see who confesses first.

Details & Fit

  • White glossy ceramic mug, 11 oz
  • Height 3.8 in (9.6 cm), diameter 3.2 in (8.2 cm)
  • Dishwasher and microwave safe
  • Design printed on both sides, so it faces out for right- and left-handed drinkers
  • Blank product sourced from China

Each mug is printed to order, so the color on your screen may differ slightly from the glaze.

The Christmas – We Said No Gifts. We Lied. Mug from Graphic Tees Co. is a white glossy ceramic mug that holds 11 ounces, about a big cup of coffee or tea. It stands 3.8 inches (9.6 cm) tall and is 3.2 inches (8.2 cm) across, with a standard handle that fits a normal hand comfortably.

Yes. The Christmas – We Said No Gifts. We Lied. Mug is dishwasher and microwave safe, so it goes from the cupboard to the microwave to the sink without fuss. The print is made to hold up to regular washing, but a gentle hand wash will keep the glossy design looking its best for as long as you own it.

Yes. Graphic Tees Co. prints the design on both sides of the Christmas – We Said No Gifts. We Lied. Mug, so the joke faces out whether you hold the handle in your right hand or your left. That also makes it easy to show off on a desk or a shelf.
